content.text: The bold rule lives in the theme's `MuiTab` overrides, not in Board. It uses the JSS `'&$selected'` reference, which Emotion doesn't resolve, so the rule is dropped. The guide says to replace state class references with `Mui-` global class names. Board imports `theme.ts`, so I'll fix it there.

input.note: Replaced JSS '&$selected' in the MuiTab theme override with '&.Mui-selected' (Emotion global state class), so the selected tab rule applies in v5.
